2609.06410.title: Visual Search Augmented Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Attribute Value Extraction from Product Videos
2609.06410.paper_summary: Existing approaches to visual attribute value extraction (AVE) primarily rely on static product images, failing to capture temporal cues, multi-angle views and fine-grained visual details. Directly applying video vision-language models (VLMs) to product AVE results in limited performance due to the lack of domain knowledge, and fine-tuning them requires extensive high-quality data and substantial computational resources. Thus, we propose visual search augmented chain-of-thought reasoning (ViS-CoT), a training-free, plug-and-play pipeline that can be easily applied to any open-source video VLM for video-to-text AVE in e-Commerce. Specifically, ViS-CoT employs visual clustering to identify representative frames, followed by visual search to retrieve semantically similar product knowledge that can enrich attribute cues. Next, an interleaved CoT reasoning module iteratively refines reasoning through visually-aligned auxiliary texts derived from captioning and automatic speech recognition. Finally, the integrated information guides the model toward accurate and fine-grained attribute predictions. Extensive experiments across 14 product categories on the VideoAVE dataset show that ViS-CoT consistently enhances multiple state-of-the-art video VLMs, achieving an average improvement of 17.91 percentage points in micro-F1.
2609.06410.paper_summary_zh: 現有的視覺屬性值提取（AVE）方法主要依賴靜態產品圖像，未能捕捉時間線索、多角度視圖和細緻的視覺細節。將視頻視覺-語言模型（VLMs）直接應用於產品AVE，由於缺乏領域知識，導致性能有限，而對其進行微調需要大量高質量數據和相當的計算資源。因此，我們提出了視覺搜索增強的思維鏈推理（ViS-CoT），這是一個無需訓練的即插即用管道，可以輕鬆應用於任何開源視頻VLM，以實現電子商務中的視頻到文本AVE。具體而言，ViS-CoT採用視覺聚類來識別代表性幀，然後通過視覺搜索檢索語義相似的產品知識，以豐富屬性線索。接下來，交錯的CoT推理模塊通過從標題和自動語音識別中獲得的視覺對齊輔助文本，迭代地精煉推理。最後，整合的信息指導模型朝向準確且細緻的屬性預測。在VideoAVE數據集上對14個產品類別進行的廣泛實驗表明，ViS-CoT持續增強多個最先進的視頻VLMs，實現了微-F1平均提升17.91個百分點。
